spec: PolicyForge Sprint 5 — CI hardening (branch chore/ci-hardening, cut from dev @ d9a5694). Read root CLAUDE.md (Stack: 'GitLab CI (.gitlab-ci.yml, added in Sprint 5) with a Claude Code review stage'), AGENTS.md, docs/harness-setup.md, docs/tdd.md, docs/knowledge-deposits.md, .claude/** (agents, skills, commands, hooks, plugin.json), scripts/ac_audit.py, scripts/redact_evidence.py, backend/pom.xml, frontend/package.json and playwright.config.ts, and the Sprint 4 follow-ups in docs/prs/PR-010.md. USER DECISIONS (2026-11-04): build BOTH (1) `.gitlab-ci.yml` meeting the capstone's GitLab CI requirement and (2) an equivalent GitHub Actions workflow under `.github/workflows/` that actually runs on this GitHub repo (origin https://github.com/wushandarshana/Policy-Forge) for pushes and PRs into dev and main. Same jobs and gates in both. The Claude Code review stage is REQUIRED to pass and uses the `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` secret (GitHub repository secret / GitLab masked protected variable) that the user is adding; never echo the key, never commit a key, never set NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0. GitHub: use the official `anthropics/claude-code-action` pinned to a released version (or a pinned `@anthropic-ai/claude-code` CLI in headless `-p` mode) with least-privilege `permissions:` (contents: read, pull-requests: write only where it comments); GitLab: pinned Claude Code CLI in headless mode, posting its review as a job artifact (and an MR note when a token exists). The review prompt must reuse the project's own `.claude/agents/security-reviewer.md` and `test-engineer.md` criteria and fail the job on any BLOCKER. Pipeline stages (both platforms): build (./mvnw -B verify with JaCoCo thresholds unchanged, SPA packaged), frontend unit (npm ci, npm test with coverage, npm run build), e2e (Playwright on Linux using the official mcr.microsoft.com/playwright image at the version matching package.json, both projects, with HTML report and traces as artifacts on failure), quality gates (python scripts/ac_audit.py --offline --no-write must report 0 NOT COVERED and 0 PARENT-ONLY; python scripts/redact_evidence.py --check over sprint-contracts specs/reviews docs/fix-loops must exit 0; the .claude hook regression suite python .claude/hooks/tests/test_hooks.py must pass; an LF line-ending check on .claude/hooks/*.sh), and the Claude review. Cache Maven and npm. Java 21 Temurin, Node matching the repo. Pin every action/image by version (or SHA). LINUX SNAPSHOTS: baselines exist only as -win32. No Docker/WSL is available locally, so Linux baselines can only be generated in CI. Planner must propose (as a G-n checkpoint item) how: e.g. a manually-dispatched GitHub workflow that runs the Playwright container with --update-snapshots and uploads the `-linux` PNGs as an artifact that the orchestrator downloads with `gh run download` and commits in a separate commit after review, while the regular e2e job runs visual assertions only when the platform's baselines exist (no silent skip of the functional E2E assertions). Generators never push; anything that requires the branch to be on GitHub must be a post-push orchestrator step listed explicitly in the plan. OTHER SPRINT 5 ITEMS (Sprint 4 follow-ups): stop tracking frontend/coverage/lcov.info (git rm --cached, .gitignore, and adjust any script, test or doc that expects it committed); an ArchUnit rule that only EndorsementService may call PolicyTermEntity.repriceOffer, with a negative fixture (security MINOR-A); an IT racing an endorsement re-price against a renewal payment (exactly one wins, no paid term with a re-priced premium); an oracle cross-check for the AC-08.5 property test (an independent BigDecimal recomputation or premium_check.py-generated cases, not the production calculator); pin `@playwright/mcp` in .mcp.json to a fixed version instead of @latest. Record SG-3, SG-5, SG-6 and SG-7 from the Sprint 4 plan as accepted v1 limitations in the relevant specs (a separate `spec:` commit by the orchestrator at the checkpoint, text proposed by the planner); SG-2 and SG-4 are already closed by AC-08.6 and AC-07.8. Update root CLAUDE.md Stack/Commands, AGENTS.md and docs/harness-setup.md to describe both pipelines and how to add the secret (substrate text proposed in the plan; the orchestrator commits substrate). Add a KD entry to docs/knowledge-deposits.md for anything learned. Every test named AC-NN.M or NFR-NN.M per root rule 8 (use NFR-08.x / NFR-02.x / AC-06.x / AC-07.x / AC-08.5 as fits; CI config itself needs a validation step, e.g. actionlint for GitHub and `gitlab-ci-local`-free YAML schema/lint check, run locally by the generator and in CI). Constraints: root CLAUDE.md non-negotiables; no edits to existing Flyway migrations or published rule files; synthetic data only. Commits: generators commit locally on chore/ci-hardening only, TDD order where code/tests change (`test(red)` before `feat(green)`/`fix(green)`; CI config in `ci:` commits), explicit paths, never push. Hard rule KD-014: run long commands in the FOREGROUND. Environment: prefix Maven with `export JAVA_HOME="/c/Program Files/Eclipse Adoptium/jdk-21.0.12.101-hotspot"; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"`; Windows host, Git Bash. Expected base: dev = d9a5694, main = 8e265d6, both unchanged; nothing pushed.
